HOW WE WORK

Search monitoring that stays connected to your business.

Every website starts from a different place. Some have an established Search Console property and a reliable sitemap; others need the essentials checking before the data can be trusted. We begin by understanding the website, the audience and the current setup. If access, verification or sitemap configuration needs attention, we deal with the limited technical work needed to establish the monitoring service. That work is deliberately focused: it supports the search foundations without turning a monthly monitoring agreement into an open-ended development project.

Once the foundations are in place, we review the signals Google makes available. Clicks and impressions help show how often a website is appearing and being selected in search. Indexed-page information helps identify whether Google is discovering the pages that matter. Query data can reveal how potential customers describe their problem or the service they need. No single metric gives the whole answer, so we compare the information over time and explain what is meaningful, what needs watching and what may simply be normal variation.

The result is an ongoing, practical view of a website's visibility. You retain control of your website and content decisions; we take care of the monitoring, core search infrastructure and interpretation that make those decisions easier. If an opportunity calls for new copy, a new page or substantial technical work, we will explain why it may be worthwhile and agree any separate work before it begins.

WHAT’S INCLUDED

SEO management built around the data that matters.

Search visibility is not a set-and-forget task. We take care of the core monitoring and configuration, then use the signals in Google Search Console to help guide your website forward.

  1. 01

    Sitemaps and Search Console

    We set up or access your Google Search Console property, check your sitemap configuration and make the essential adjustments needed to help Google discover your website's pages. Where necessary, we can configure automatic sitemap generation and submit your sitemap to Google.

  2. 02

    Search performance tracking

    We monitor your website's organic search clicks, impressions and indexed pages. Each month, you'll receive a clear report showing how your website is performing, how the figures compare with previous periods and how its visibility is developing.

  3. 03

    Keyword and content opportunities

    We analyse the searches that bring your website into Google's results and identify promising keywords worth targeting. Our recommendations help you plan useful new content or improve existing pages, giving your website a clearer direction for future growth.

HOW THE SERVICE STAYS FOCUSED

Focused SEO support, without unnecessary extras.

Our service concentrates on search monitoring, sitemap management and identifying opportunities for improvement. We may make small technical configuration changes where needed, but writing website content and carrying out bespoke development aren't included in the monthly service.

When we recommend new content or more substantial website changes, you can arrange these with your existing developer or content provider. Anything outside the agreed monitoring and configuration scope is discussed and authorised separately.

A SENSIBLE STARTING POINT

Designed for businesses that want visibility without the noise.

SEO Management is useful when you want someone to look after the ongoing search picture while you remain focused on running the business. Instead of logging into several platforms, interpreting unfamiliar charts or wondering whether a sitemap has been maintained, you have a regular point of reference and a clear report. That does not remove the need for good services, helpful information or a website that customers can use. It does mean the search-monitoring work is owned, checked and explained rather than left to chance.

We make recommendations in the context of the information available. A page may need a clearer explanation, an important service may deserve its own page or a repeated search query may point to a useful future article. We will show you the opportunity and its reasoning. You choose the priorities and retain control over content and bigger website decisions. Where a small configuration change is necessary to maintain the agreed service, we discuss it plainly; where an improvement is broader than the subscription, we agree it separately.

This makes the service straightforward to begin and straightforward to maintain. You know what is being monitored, what you receive each month and where a recommendation ends and separately scoped delivery begins.
